title: The integral of a directional derivative of a compactly supported C¹ function vanishes (parent Step 4)
statement: Let k ∈ ℕ, let h : ℝ^k → ℝ (h : Eucl k → ℝ) be of class C¹ with compact support, and let e ∈ ℝ^k. Then ∫_{ℝ^k} Dh(w)(e) dw = 0, where Dh(w) = fderiv ℝ h w is the Fréchet derivative of h at w and dw is Lebesgue measure (volume) on Eucl k.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (h : Eucl k → ℝ) (e : Eucl k), ContDiff ℝ 1 h → HasCompactSupport h → ∫ w, fderiv ℝ h w e ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k)) = 0
